title: My VeloBuild CX-002 Is FINISHED! - Total Winner

takeaways.text: It feels as stiff and responsive as a road race frame without being harsh, on 32 mm slicks and ENVE wheels.
The geometry is short, as befits cyclocross; for fast road rides he would fit a longer, more negative stem. Clearance is up to 42 mm.
He routed the cables through an FSA headset system, so bars and stems are easy to swap.
On the first ride there were no creaks, rattles or headset play, a known pain point for VeloBuild customers; he foamed the brake hose inside the down tube.

disclosure: VeloBuild sent the frameset; the build uses his own SRAM Rival eTap AXS and ENVE wheels.
summary: First ride on Patrick Lino's finished VeloBuild CX-002 build.
